title: Spotlight on… Hanoi
summary: This C40 case study describes “Spotlight on… Hanoi,” an urban initiative documented for Hanoi. It is included because it addresses river flood, heatwave hazards, and it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: Hanoi Chairman, Tran Sy Thanh, on the climate impacts experienced in Hanoi, Vietnam.

intervention.objectives: Hanoi Chairman, Tran Sy Thanh, on the climate impacts experienced in Hanoi, Vietnam.
intervention.measures:
Vietnam has long experienced direct impacts of the climate crisis, such as extreme weather events like intense storms, floods and heatwaves. But as global temperatures rise, the frequency has increased, upping the threat to residents and livelihoods.
